name: Cultuurhuis Bergeijk
funding: The Municipality of Bergeijk gave EUR 78,000 of EUR 112,473 income in 2025. Friends of the Cultuurhuis gave EUR 10,000 and Postcode Loterij Buurtfonds EUR 5,000. Operations earned EUR 16,518.

name: De Nollen
funding: Entry and workshops gave EUR 87k of EUR 138k in 2025. The municipality gave EUR 23.5k and RVO a EUR 3.7k nature-management subsidy. Rabobank holds a EUR 180k loan.

name: Van Doesburg-Rinsemahuis
funding: Museum Dr8888 runs it. In 2025 subsidy was EUR 884k of EUR 1.189M income. Subsidy from Smallingerland and the province of Fryslân is its essential base.

name: Jachthuis Sint Hubertus
funding: The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf pays the house's maintenance. 47 firms, including Pon and OHRA, sponsor the Park.

name: Cuypershuis
funding: Part of the municipality of Roermond, which subsidises its core tasks. Stichting Vrienden Cuypershuis Roermond backs acquisitions and exhibitions, and the museum takes donations and bequests.

name: Chabot Museum
funding: Income EUR 1.18M in 2025: Droom en Daad EUR 350k, VriendenLoterij EUR 212k, Gemeente Rotterdam EUR 205k, individual and company gifts EUR 216k, own income EUR 190k, Cultuurfonds EUR 2k.

name: Kijk-Kubus
funding: Not confirmed. The Het Blaakse Bos Foundation runs the show cube and charges EUR 3.50 admission. No accounts, funder list or ANBI number is published.

name: Sonneveld House
funding: Het Nieuwe Instituut runs it. The Ministry of OCW paid EUR 13.2M of the institute's EUR 16.6M income in 2025. VriendenLoterij gave EUR 132k, other public subsidies EUR 1.3M.

name: Huis Jan de Jong
funding: Owned by Vereniging Hendrick de Keyser, funded by rents and services (EUR 16.9M in 2025), bequests (EUR 4.3M), the VriendenLoterij (EUR 1.2M a year) and government subsidies (EUR 1.5M).

name: Van Schijndel House
funding: Not confirmed. The volunteer-run Mart van Schijndel Foundation (set up 2008) runs visits for a EUR 45 donation. The house is still privately lived in and no owner is named.

name: Vigeland Museum
funding: Part of Kulturetaten, the City of Oslo's culture agency, and paid from the city budget.

name: Munchs hus
funding: Vestfoldmuseene IKS, its operator, got NOK 44.3M from the state, 31.5M from Vestfold county and 15.5M from owner municipalities in 2024. Sparebankstiftelsen DNB funds projects at other sites.
